entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that stores mobility history information and performs the procedures described in this clause.

entities.name: VarMobilityHistoryReport
entities.description: A variable in the UE that stores mobility history information including visited cell lists.

entities.name: visitedPSCellInfoList
entities.description: A list in VarMobilityHistoryReport that stores information about visited PSCells including cell identity and time spent.

entities.name: visitedCellInfoList
entities.description: A list in VarMobilityHistoryReport that stores information about visited PCells/serving cells including cell identity and time spent.

entities.name: PSCell Addition
entities.description: Procedure triggered when a PSCell is added to the UE configuration.

entities.name: PSCell Change/Release/Failure
entities.description: Procedure triggered when a PSCell is changed, released, or when SCG failure occurs.

entities.name: PCell Change
entities.description: Procedure triggered when the UE changes PCell while in RRC_CONNECTED state.

entities.name: Transition to Camped Normally State
entities.description: Procedure triggered when UE enters camped normally state from RRC_CONNECTED or cell selection states.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where the UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is not actively connected but can perform cell selection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where the UE is not actively transmitting but maintains some connection context.

relations.description: PSCell addition procedure includes adding an entry to visitedPSCellInfoList.
PSCell change/release/failure procedure includes adding an entry to visitedPSCellInfoList.
PCell change procedure includes adding an entry to visitedCellInfoList.
Transition to camped normally state includes adding an entry to visitedPSCellInfoList.
visitedPSCellInfoList is contained within VarMobilityHistoryReport variable.
visitedCellInfoList is contained within VarMobilityHistoryReport variable.
PSCell addition procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Transition to camped normally state requires UE to enter RRC_IDLE state.
Transition to camped normally state requires UE to enter RRC_INACTIVE state.
